title: Stage check: Becoming independent
outcomes: Tests, without names or labels, whether checks, captures, threats and quiet moves are found in mixed positions
Shows whether you can decline a tempting capture or tactic when it does not work
Shows whether you can predict the opponent's reply before choosing your own move
Gives you a concrete question to redo from this stage

steps.text: This is a **check**, not a lesson. Fourteen positions, no names, no hints about what to look for. Some have a sharp answer, some want a calm move, and in some the best choice is to leave a tempting idea alone. A few ask what your opponent will do next. Answers stay unmarked until the end.

steps.prompt: Pick one position you would redo. What was the position missing that would have made you sure: a move you had not looked at, a reply you had not checked, or a piece you had misjudged? Name the square or the piece.

fields.label: Which question would you redo (number 1 to 14)?
What was missing?
options: a move I had not looked at
I did not know the ending
